clusters.change: Add rows to 01 1.7: operator (the person who runs romeu on a host, owns host settings and answers the gates; Not: user, developer); maintainer (the person who merges and releases the product repository; today the same person as the operator); this specification (Not: the spec, for this document); product kit (Not: mixin; 06 6.4 'Kind: mixin' stays as sbx's field value, in code font); drift (a live derived file whose hash differs from render.json); promotion and interrupted promotion (01 1.6); preflight (01 1.5); recreate needed (Not: stale, for the recreate digest); orphaned (a repo dir no spec names, J13); romeu command (Not: session, in 03 3.6 and 06 6.3). Fill the Not column of existing rows where a rival word is in use. Replace the self-references the gate then flags. Deferred row: a generated glossary page from this table, reopened by the first guide page that needs it.
clusters.cost: About twelve rows and the substitutions the gate then demands.
clusters.resolution_text: One pass adds the rows the five findings name; rows for 'tool', 'host tool' and 'compatibility check' wait until a rival word is found in use; the glossary generator is deferred.

clusters.title: The word sandbox names both the development sandbox this repository is built in (ADR 0008, the operator's keys) and a romeu-managed sandbox (06 6.4, one signing key), with one row in 01 1.7 and no page saying which is meant.
clusters.scenario: A security reviewer reads 06 6.4 and concludes this product's own agent can only sign; a contributor reads ADR 0008 and concludes every romeu sandbox forwards the GitHub key; the 05 5.4 token rows are read as the product's security model.
clusters.change: Add a row to 01 1.7: 'development sandbox | the sbx sandbox this repository is developed in, provisioned outside romeu with the operator's account and keys; ADR 0008 and the token rows of 05 5.4 mean this | -'. Make the sandbox row read 'a sandbox romeu created or adopted for a project'. In 05 5.4 (the two token rows and the Verified-signature row) and the deferred token rows, write development sandbox. Leave the text of ADR 0008 as it stands; the vocabulary row tells its reader which sandbox it means.
clusters.cost: One row, one cell, about eight substitutions.
clusters.resolution_text: Apply in the spec pages and leave the decision record unchanged, so no ADR edit is needed; 05 5.4 changes wording only, no accepted risk.

clusters.title: The vocabulary table and the index's tables are check inputs, yet docs/spec/** is on no ask-first surface, while the generated denylist's path is not named and, if under tools/ci, every vocabulary edit crosses the checks surface.
clusters.scenario: An agent PR edits the Not column of 01 1.7 to make its own wording pass and rewrites a 05 5.4 row, with no approval line; or a docs PR adding a vocabulary row needs a checks approval for a word.
clusters.change: Name the generated denylist's path in 01 1.7 and 12 12.3, outside the checks globs (for example docs/reference/vocabulary.yaml), and either add docs/spec.md and docs/spec/** to .github/ask-first.yaml as a 'specification' surface or state in 05 5.3 why the spec stays off the list.
clusters.cost: One path; one glob or one sentence in 05 5.3.
clusters.resolution_text: Operator: which paths are ask-first is the operator's decision on a security-model surface. Recommendation: name the generated path outside tools/ci, and add the specification surface, since 05 5.4 and the gate inputs live there.
clusters.operator_reason: Operator: which paths are ask-first is the operator's decision on a security-model surface.

clusters.title: retire moves a project to .attic and never deletes, and nothing tells the owner how to delete what they own (.attic, the state attic, salvage payloads).
clusters.scenario: Years of retired projects pile up under $ROMEU_ROOT/.attic; the owner wants them gone and finds no word on which directories are safe to remove or whether status or doctor will complain.
clusters.change: In the 01 1.7 retire row append: 'what retire moves is the owner's to delete by hand (J7 step 4)'. Add J7 step 4: 'once status shows nothing unpushed for the project, the operator may delete $ROMEU_ROOT/.attic/<name>/<ts>/ and $XDG_STATE_HOME/romeu/attic/<name>/<ts>/; romeu never does, and status and doctor do not read them.' Add a test that deletes an attic and runs status and doctor.
clusters.cost: One clause, one journey step, one test.
clusters.resolution_text: Apply.
